kurals.tr: Arumai Utaiththendru Asaavaamai Ventum / Perumai Muyarsi Tharum
kurals.m: Yield not to the feebleness which says, "this is too difficult to be done"; labour will give the greatness (of mind) which is necessary (to do it)

kurals.tr: Vinaikkan Vinaiketal Ompal Vinaikkurai / Theerndhaarin Theerndhandru Ulaku
kurals.m: Take care not to give up exertion in the midst of a work; the world will abandon those who abandon their unfinished work

kurals.tr: Thaalaanmai Ennum Thakaimaikkan Thangitre / Velaanmai Ennunj Cherukku
kurals.m: The lustre of munificence will dwell only with the dignity of laboriousness or efforts

kurals.tr: Thaalaanmai Illaadhaan Velaanmai Petikai / Vaalaanmai Polak Ketum
kurals.m: The liberality of him, who does not labour, will fail, like the manliness of a hermaphrodite, who has a sword in its hand

kurals.tr: Inpam Vizhaiyaan Vinaivizhaivaan Thankelir / Thunpam Thutaiththoondrum Thoon
kurals.m: He who desires not pleasure, but desires labour, will be a pillar to sustain his relations, wiping away their sorrows

kurals.tr: Muyarsi Thiruvinai Aakkum Muyatrinmai / Inmai Pukuththi Vitum
kurals.m: Labour will produce wealth; idleness will bring poverty

kurals.tr: Matiyulaal Maamukati Enpa Matiyilaan / Thaalulaan Thaamaraiyi Naal
kurals.m: They say that the black Mudevi (the goddess of adversity) dwells with laziness, and the Latchmi (the goddess of prosperity) dwells with the labour of the industrious

kurals.tr: Poriyinmai Yaarkkum Pazhiyandru Arivarindhu / Aalvinai Inmai Pazhi
kurals.m: Adverse fate is no disgrace to any one; to be without exertion and without knowing what should be known, is disgrace

kurals.tr: Theyvaththaan Aakaa Theninum Muyarsidhan / Meyvaruththak Kooli Tharum
kurals.m: Although it be said that, through fate, it cannot be attained, yet labour, with bodily exertion, will yield its reward

kurals.tr: Oozhaiyum Uppakkam Kaanpar Ulaivindrith / Thaazhaadhu Ugnatru Pavar
kurals.m: They who labour on, without fear and without fainting will see even fate (put) behind their back
